parts.text: $MS: revenue growth slowed to +12% from +27% the quarter before. Q3 revenue reached $20.3B with a 31.9% operating margin and $4.9B in net earnings. 👇 #earnings #finance
$LYV: revenue growth sped up to +19% to $10.1B, led by international concert fans, while operating margin held at 8.8%. 👇 #earnings #media
$EOG: operating profit grew faster than sales, +95% vs +46%. Q3 revenue $8.5B with a 41.9% margin. 👇 #earnings #oil
$RGA: profit grew faster than sales in Q3 (preliminary) — operating profit surged +95% vs revenue +22% to $7.5B, lifting operating margin to 8.3%. Net earnings reached $457M. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$C: profit is growing faster than sales — revenue +8% to $23.8B, operating margin 30.6%. Q3 net earnings reached $5.2B. 👇 #earnings #banks
$DVN: sold more but kept less — revenue +58% to $6.9B, operating margin 18.3% (preliminary). Q3 costs grew faster than sales. 👇 #earnings #oil
$ED: operating profit grew faster than sales, +21% vs +8%. Q3 revenue $4.9B, operating margin 23.8%. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$ABNB: about 42¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit. Q3 revenue $4.9B (+19% Y/Y), net earnings $1.9B. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$APO: revenue fell 52% from a year ago to $4.7B, driven by Retirement Services. Operating margin hit -30.9% with a net loss of $1.1B. 👇 #earnings #finance
$COMP: cash came in ahead of profit (preliminary) — operating cash flow $248M was nearly 4x net earnings of $63M on revenue of $3.9B (+111% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #realestate
$GPN: revenue grew 64% but operating profit fell 68% — Q3 revenue $3.3B, operating margin 7.4%. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$ATH-PA: revenue fell 62% to $3.1B in Q3 2026, leading to a net loss of $1.3B and an operating margin of -56.7%. 👇 #earnings #insurance
